column7: AddProjectMember (POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/members) returned 500 instead of 403 for a legitimate requireGranterHoldsRolePermissions ceiling refusal (core.ErrPermissionDenied), because its status-code switch classified errors by message substring and had no errors.Is(err, core.ErrPermissionDenied) case, unlike UpdateProjectMember's otherwise-identical switch. Found while fixing authzdiff known-06/D6 in the same handler. Fixed by adding that case before the switch's default branch.
